title: Widgets squad, round 3
intro: A made-up squad lead's grill, to show urgency, issue references and who asked. The concepts are the default view; the sidebar also lists the same questions by issue or by urgency.

parts.title: Not losing work
parts.summary: What happens to a job or a delivery when something fails.

parts.title: When things run
parts.summary: Windows and removals that affect customers' days.

parts.title: Limits
parts.summary: How much a single key may ask of the API.

steps.heading: When a webhook gives up
prose: PR #212 retries forever today. The receiver side has no dedupe, so every retry is a duplicate risk.

question.title: Retry ceiling
question.ask: Should a webhook give up after 8 tries over 24 hours?

options.label: 8 tries over 24 hours
options.effect: Failed deliveries stop on day two and land in the dead-letter list.

options.label: 20 tries over 3 days
options.effect: Longer outages recover, at triple the duplicate risk.

steps.heading: Where a give-up goes
prose: The reviewer on #212 found nowhere for a give-up to go.

question.title: Dead letters
question.ask: Should failed deliveries go to a dead-letter table the admin page lists?

options.label: Dead-letter table plus admin list
options.effect: One more table; support can replay by hand.

options.label: Log only
options.effect: Nothing to build; failures are invisible to support.

steps.heading: One job or many
prose: Draft PR #215 runs one job across all tenants, which ADR 0012 rules out.

question.title: Tenant fan-out
question.ask: Should the export job enqueue one child job per tenant, per ADR 0012?

options.label: One child job per tenant
options.effect: Follows ADR 0012; 300 jobs a night instead of one.

options.label: Keep one job, supersede ADR 0012
options.effect: Simpler queue, but a slow tenant delays everyone.

steps.heading: When exports run
prose: Fan-out makes the window longer; nobody has asked to move it yet.

question.title: Export window
question.ask: Should exports keep running at 02:00 UTC?

steps.heading: When the importer goes
prose: Two tenants used it last month.

question.title: Importer removal
question.ask: Should SQD-107 wait until no tenant has used the CSV importer for 30 days?

options.label: Wait for 30 quiet days
options.effect: Removal slips at least a month.

options.label: Remove now with a notice
options.effect: Two tenants need a new path this week.

steps.heading: How hard to limit
prose: No traffic data yet, so the number is a guess.

question.title: Limit per key
question.ask: Should the search API allow 60 requests a minute per key?

options.label: 60 a minute
options.effect: Covers every key seen last week.

next: Answers to Q1 and Q3 unblock both builders.

decided.text: Webhooks sign every delivery with the tenant key (round 1).
